revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Rebuilt opening on three corrections to A1. (1) The route-2 frame-0 rush is answered by the only unit that is simultaneously <=10 DP at f0, block-2, self-cheapened (runtime-supported), a DP engine, and durable enough to solo-hold and solo-kill: Fang at [4,3] facing LEFT — she arrests route-2 by f27 and grinds it out (~f627) with zero ranged support, freeing every other resource. (2) The [8,5] lane-01 anchor is rebuilt device-legally: instead of the roadblock-locked [9,2] caper, the block is Friston-3 (3 DP, block-3, DEF 235) on the ground tile itself by f191, and the fire is a crossfire from two legal high grounds — GALLUS² (3 DP arts, ~130 DPS vs RES 20) at [9,5] LEFT from f180 and Kroos (11 DP, ~390 effective DPS with her AUTO skill) at [7,5] RIGHT from f510 — timed so route-1 dies ~f590 and route-3 ~f718, bracketing the f431 double-block pressure spike that is Friston-3's only lethal window; Lancet-2 at [6,5] RIGHT (f570, runtime-supported +200 global burst) carries Friston-3 through it and leaves it standing at f941 to catch route-4's first arrival. (3) The lane-02 uterer triplet is handled as an explicit, budgeted concession set: route-6 (~f768) and route-8 (~f803, no legal interception tiles) are conceded because no interception+kill package is payable by those frames, while Yato at [5,1] (f630, by route-7's latest block 725) pushes route-7's leak to ~f946-1081. Economy is upkeep-free, refund-free, and slack-audited at every action; within-window life is 3 baseline, 1 in the certified worst case (fast enemy attack intervals collapsing Friston-3 before f718), 5 only if Fang also collapses — the plan's single named sensitivity.
